responses.draft_cover_letter:
I am eager to join Quill AI Lab’s Language Models team and contribute to advancing pre‑training research. Although I do not yet hold a PhD or have published at NeurIPS or ICML, I am highly motivated to deepen my expertise in machine‑learning research and to acquire the rigorous scientific skills required for this role.

I look forward to learning the practical aspects of large‑scale transformer training, multi‑node GPU clusters, and distributed frameworks such as FSDP and DeepSpeed, and to applying that knowledge toward impactful research at Quill AI Lab.
